title: Monero GUI wallet files
whyItMatters: Monero wallet .keys files hold the spend key protected only by the wallet password. A copy lets someone try passwords offline and take the funds.
source: Monero GUI Windows installer creates and uses Documents/Monero/wallets as the default wallet folder: https://github.com/monero-project/monero-gui/blob/master/installers/windows/Monero.iss
notes: Default location created by the installer. The wizard lets the user pick another folder, so a wallet saved elsewhere is only caught by the personal-folder rules. App settings and logs live in %APPDATA% monero-gui, not here.
